description: Mint a short-lived Postgres credential against a target and return a ready-to-use connection URL. The password is generated on THIS machine and only its SCRAM verifier is sent to the API — the plaintext never reaches seekrit or Postgres at rest. The role auto-expires; revoke early with revoke_pg_lease.

role.description: role name to create (default: random tmp_ name)

name: create_pg_lease
